description: Read an EU e-invoice (XRechnung UBL or CII, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with embedded XML, Peppol UBL) and get clean JSON: seller, buyer, VAT IDs, invoice number, dates, line items, net/VAT/gross totals, IBAN, payment terms, plus checks (totals add up, IBAN valid, mandatory fields present) and CSV of the lines. Germany requires receiving e-invoices since 2025. Runs on our server, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/e-invoice-reader.
